## ServerOptions.register property

Registers apps from their generated contracts on the server's runtime.

**Signature:**

```typescript
register?: (registrar: AppRegistrar) => void;
```

## Remarks

Called once, synchronously, while the server is constructed: after any manifests passed as the first parameter are registered, and before the operation routes are built, so every app it registers is served. Register an app with `registrar.registerContract(contract, manifest)`<!-- -->.

A throw from the callback propagates out of the server factory. A caller that wants to serve the apps that do register when another is refused catches per app; each registration is atomic.

## Example

```typescript
import { createMultiServer } from '@macts/api/server'
import { AppManifestSchema } from '@macts/core'
import { notesContract } from '@macts/notes/contract'

const manifest = AppManifestSchema.parse(await notesContract.loadManifest())
const server = createMultiServer([], {
  register: (registrar) => registrar.registerContract(notesContract, manifest),
})
```
